targets.measured: of the creatures a daily player has owned for two weeks or more, 100% are within 5 levels of their 3rd best at week 4 (worst 4 levels below the 3rd best, median 2, worst without those held at the evolution level 2) and 70% at week 8 (worst 10 levels below the 3rd best, median 3, worst without those held at the evolution level 6); the 6th creature (a second team's best) is 3 below the 3rd at week 8. An optimiser's share at week 4 is 100% (pass). It also depends on how fast creatures arrive: at the docs' 2% an hour (the default here is 1.3%) a set-and-forget player's share at week 4 is 100% (pass) and an optimiser's 100% (pass)
targets.target: creatures owned two weeks or more within 5 levels of the 3rd best at weeks 4 and 8, and two strong teams at week 8

targets.measured: an optimiser visiting three times a day gets 105% of an optimiser visiting once in XP and 100% in posts' and the allowance's output over 24 weeks. In the model extra visits add no rate (idle gains run at the same rate however often a player looks in), so this passes by construction: it shows only that nothing in the rules pays a frequent visitor more, not that choices are worth little
a weekend-off player gets 98% of a daily player's idle growth (effective hours, weeks 1 to 12)
targets.target: about 100% (a weekend off costs almost nothing)

targets.measured: a weekly player's XP per creature, catch-up included, is 82% of a daily player's (idle gains alone: 79%; with fights: 84%; their best creature is level 27 at week 12 against a daily player's 29). Their scouts bring home 41% of a daily player's finds per seat (stores of three days: about 72 of 168 hours)
targets.target: about 75% to 80% of a daily player's XP per creature (goals.md T-2)

targets.measured: a player back after four weeks away keeps every level (best creature +4 levels vs before) and their 3rd-best creature is within 2 levels of the server's middle after 10 days of visits (the target is about 14; if catch-up also boosted fight XP: 5 days)
targets.target: recognises the roster; within about two weeks of daily visits of the server's middle (V-BON-2)

targets.measured: a server of 8 lifts its first place a level on day 7.8; its first collection is done in week 4 (the docs expect weeks 3 to 4) and 4 collections are done by week 12 (no project needs one)
targets.target: first level within 14 days; the rare-find route matters (at least one collection by week 12) without being required

targets.measured: by week 12 a server of 8 has 5 place level-ups across the valley and a fire of 46 if it kills every boss (64 at week 23)
targets.target: about 5 to 6 level-ups by week 12; the fire about 50 at week 12 and under about 100 before week 24 (commons.md)

targets.measured: in the worst week (weeks 2 to 12) a typical player's anvils tinker for want of scrap 0% of the time (daily, week 2)
targets.target: at most 10% for want of scrap

targets.measured: for want of a shard of the element the team needs, the worst week is 88% (weekly, week 4); averaged over weeks 2 to 12 that profile loses 64%. With the Forge floor full the worst week is 9% (weekly, week 5), mean 1%
targets.target: goals.md T-4 names scrap only; shards are shown for the same 10%

targets.measured: a daily player owns 11 lines at week 4 and 25 at week 12 (with the forms they evolved into: 16 and 44); 100% of the starting pool's commons are owned by week 6; at week 24 41% of the rares and 13% of the epics released are owned
targets.target: about 9 to 12 lines at week 4, 20 to 28 at week 12, most commons within 6 weeks, rares over months (15% to 60% by week 24), epics rarely (at most 35%)

targets.measured: 3 creatures of a daily player wait at their evolution level for Essence at week 12
targets.target: at most 3: Essence must not be starved to keep the pile down

targets.measured: 3 of a daily player's 4 resources (Acorns, scrap, shards, Essence) are dead (a pile rising 4 weeks running to 4 weeks of what the resource is spent on) before week 12
targets.target: none (resources.md: nothing that only piles up). Shown, not judged, until the visitor and decorations are modelled (Q42 B: sinks come later; piling up is alright for the first few weeks). The dead flags stay in the ledger

targets.measured: a daily player's best creature is level 27 at week 10 and 29 at week 12; it reaches level 30 on day 89
targets.target: still growing in week 12 (example: level 29 of 30), not capped by week 10
